company_notes: Initial inbound: pilot request from Head of Data (Aisha Patel) — interested in personalized product recommendations + support assistant.
Security team ran SOC2 checklist; Acceptable but wanted data residency options and KMS integration — asked for Private offering pricing.
During evaluation AE demonstrated hosted API throughput numbers; SE ran 2-day POC with Redwood dedicated on a small shard.
POC results: latency good, cost estimates within range but internal infra team said preference for 'single vendor simplicity'.
Late-stage friction: procurement pushed for public cloud vendor with simple API (OpenAI) to reduce ops overhead.
Final decision: procurement + CTO recommended OpenAI direct API. Quote from CTO: 'We want to minimize integration surface — OpenAI checks the box quickly.'
No formal security disqualifier — decision driven by brand/simplicity and a need to move fast for Q1 feature launch.
AE attempted rescue with 1:1 with CTO offering a canary + fallbacks; CTO declined citing org mandate to standardize on OpenAI for next 12 months.
Next actions: log win/loss, tag account for re-engagement in 12 months, add to nurture program for Dedicated offering.
